verdict.rationale: Docs describe a documented Checkout/Payment Acceptance API with two-step auth and capture flow, stable deposit addresses that auto-credit accounts, control over auth/capture/partial capture/voids, acceptance in USDC/USDT from any wallet or Coinbase account, and a sandbox for testing before going live — covering create, present, and confirm/settle programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation of the full flow working end-to-end and a public OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), so it rests on first-party docs only.
